2. **Sharp dense-sampling stable persistence constant**, Mendonça–Smii2608.17927v3 Conj6.1p19. Let X_n=aX_(n-1)+xi_n, x>0, iid symmetric alpha-stable xi with characteristic function exp(-sigma^alpha|q|^alpha),0<alpha<2. Define Lambda=-lim_n n^-1 log P_x(X_1>0,...,X_n>0), independent of x,sigma. Prove lim_{a↑1}Lambda/log(1/a)=alpha/2. This is the entire conjecture, not one alpha instance. **Nearest proof:** Theorems1.2/5.4 give existence and an upper bound alpha/2; continuous log-time survival Lemma5.2 gives rate1/2; actual proof uses stable moments and domination. **Mechanism:** compare sampled killing with continuously killed stable OU kernels in a weighted positive-operator space; establish convergence of long-time spectral rates. **Decisive next calculation:** a uniform-in-h bound on su

The full target is one smooth metric on closed connected S³×S¹, one fixed ε₀>0, and nonzero real smooth Laplace eigenfunctions with positive λ_i→∞ and H³_g(Z(u_i))/λ_i^(1/2+ε₀)→∞. Weighted operators without their metric realization, a moving metric, qualitative excess, and the envelope lemma alone do not satisfy this target. None is substituted here. The scope copy is byte-for-byte immutable. The proof uses the accepted pinned revision fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb; it does not audit truth of its original theorems. All 31 copied pinned blobs match their entries in the complete 13,223-entry catalogue, truncated=false. In particular [P]'s original base is S⁴, not S³.
